Welcome to Regulatory Reconnaissance, your regulatory news and intelligence briefing.

BARCELONA – A panel of experts at the RAPS AI in Regulatory Conference discussed how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used by a wide range of stakeholders, including notified bodies and healthcare product manufacturers.
